# ICMP ping (`source_type: icmp`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Pings a host and reports latency, packet loss or reachability, chosen by `interpretation`.

- Runs on: an Observer Agent (set the metric's `agent` to its name)
- Thresholds: required when the metric is created (all four fields)
- testProbe: supported

## Value and unit

- `interpretation: latency` (default): `ms`: average round-trip time in milliseconds
- `interpretation: packet_loss`: `%`: percentage of pings lost, 0 to 100
- `interpretation: reachability`: no unit: 1 when any ping returned, 0 when none did

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | yes | string |  | up to 253 characters |
| `count` | no | integer | `3` | 1 to 10 |
| `timeout_ms` | no | integer | `1000` | 100 to 5000 |
| `interpretation` | no | enum | `"latency"` | `latency`, `packet_loss`, `reachability` |

## Rules

- Needs the system `ping` and the NET_RAW capability on the agent host. The published container image has no `ping`, so icmp reports `no_data` there; use the standalone binary or a custom image.
- `host` is a hostname or IPv4 address and may not start with `-`.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: icmp
source_config: {"host":"gateway.internal","count":3,"interpretation":"packet_loss"}
```
